title: Cyrus and the Vow
author: Paloma Dunmore
blurb: Bram Thackeray, a lighthouse keeper's granddaughter and part-time novelist, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. Then the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must forgive the person in the mirror first before the bakery lease runs out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
